title: Card number checksum
prompt: Read lines from standard input, each holding a payment card number. Lines that are empty or contain only spaces are skipped. For every other line, first remove all spaces and dashes (`-`) from it. If what is left is not made only of digits, or has fewer than 13 or more than 19 digits, print `bad format`. Otherwise apply the Luhn check: starting from the rightmost digit and moving left, double every second digit (the second, fourth, ... from the right); if doubling gives a number above 9, subtract 9; the number is valid when the sum of all the resulting digits is a multiple of 10. Print `valid` or `bad checksum`.
